cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot slowly raises its arm to a greeting height, then performs a bouncy side-to-side waving motion, first vigorously and then more gently, before slowly lowering its arm.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot's arm subtly prepares, then lifts quickly to eye-level for a brief acknowledgement, and gently lowers to a relaxed, mid-torso position, conveying a polite greeting.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot starts in a respectful stance, then gracefully bows forward and down to convey respect or greeting, holds the bow, and then slowly returns to an upright position.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot arm prepares by slightly lifting, then extends smoothly forward, rotating its gripper to a vertical position to offer a handshake, holding it confidently before gently retracting slightly.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with a vertical gripper orientation (setup), then performs a rhythmic vertical up-and-down motion as if shaking a hand (core action), before gently settling the arm back (follow-through).

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot arm starts in a slightly open position, then gracefully sweeps across its body to simulate wrapping around the opposite side, holding the embrace for comfort or self-soothing, and finally settling into the position.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot's arm gently rises in anticipation, brings its gripper 'fingertips' to its 'lips', then performs a clear outward 'blowing' motion, concluding with a soft retraction.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot arm slowly rises above its head, with the gripper open horizontally. It then sweeps downwards and outwards to the right, followed by an inward and upward curve to form one lobe of a large heart shape, holding briefly at the symbolic bottom point, before gently retracting and settling.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot slowly raises its arm and places its gripper flat over its chest, holding the position to express sincerity or gratitude, then gently withdraws.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot starts with its arm slightly pulled inward and down, building tension (setup). It then explosively thrusts its arm high above its head, holding it in a triumphant pose (core action), before settling slightly with a proud, sustained posture (follow-through).

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot arm starts in a mid-level, anticipatory pose, then swiftly pumps its fist downward in a strong, emphatic motion, holding briefly to convey success or triumph, and finally settles into a confident stance.

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot prepares with a subtle inward pull, then rapidly flexes its arm, holding the pose to display strength, and finishes with a slow, confident release.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot initiates with a subtle forward lean, then performs two distinct up-and-down nodding motions to confirm agreement, concluding with a relaxed, slightly lowered posture.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot arm moves to a head-level position, then performs a series of quick, diminishing lateral oscillations to signal 'No', concluding with a subtle settling movement.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot conveys uncertainty by starting from a neutral stance, then quickly raising its arm to chest height with the gripper opening upwards, subtly 'shrugging' with a brief hold, and finally slowly lowering the arm.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot starts in a thoughtful pose, slowly raises its arm to the side of its head, makes small, quick scratching motions at the temple, holds, and then slowly lowers its arm, conveying confusion or contemplation.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot expresses curiosity by starting in a thoughtful pose, leaning slightly forward, then performing a subtle head tilt (via gripper orientation and arm movement) and holding it, before slowly returning to a contemplative state.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot slowly brings its hand up to its face, gently presses its palm against its forehead/eyes, holds the pose for a moment of quiet frustration, then slowly lowers its hand back down in resignation.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot subtly prepares, then quickly extends its arm to point firmly at its own chest, holding the gesture, and finally retracts slightly to signify 'me' or 'I'.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot's arm starts in a neutral position, briefly pulls back in anticipation, then quickly extends forward with the gripper pointed (like an index finger) to emphasize 'you', holds the pose, and finally retracts and lowers slightly.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm in an inviting manner (setup), then performs a series of repetitive, inward-curling gestures with the wrist, signaling 'come here' (core action), and finishes by gently lowering the arm (follow-through).

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot prepares by drawing its arm slightly back, then swiftly extends its palm forward and flat to signal 'stop' or 'wait', holding the pose with authority before a slow, resolute retraction.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot arm starts in a neutral-forward position, performs a deliberate preparatory lift, then swiftly raises its gripper to point directly upward near its head, holding this significant pose for emphasis, before slowly and gently lowering its arm.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot's arm moves to a preparatory stance, then swiftly brings the gripper to its lips to mimic placing an index finger for 'shh', holding the pose with emphasis, and then gently withdrawing.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot's arm moves to its mid-section, performs a few gentle, light pats on the stomach, conveying a sense of hunger or fullness, and then slowly withdraws.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot arm slowly draws inward, reaching towards its own chest/shoulder area to simulate covering up from cold. It then performs several short, lateral back-and-forth rubbing motions across the chest, before slowly withdrawing and settling into a slightly slumped posture.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot's arm slightly raises in preparation, then quickly moves its open hand to the side of its face and performs a vigorous fanning motion that gradually slows, before finally wiping its forehead and gently lowering its arm, conveying relief or exhaustion.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot slumps slightly, then slowly raises its hand to cover its mouth, holding the 'yawn' pose, before slowly lowering its hand in a relaxed manner.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot conveys fatigue by first slumping slightly, then slowly raising its hand to its left temple/eye area, performing a gentle circular rubbing motion, and finally withdrawing its hand to settle into a relaxed, tired posture.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot initiates a subtle head-down motion to show contrition (setup), then performs a slow, deep bow by bending at the 'waist' (shoulder-elbow) and holds this humble posture (core action), before slowly rising to a respectfully lowered final stance (follow-through).

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot's arm slowly rises to an expressive mid-level, performs two distinct 'air quote' finger flexes by rotating the wrist, and then gently lowers.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot arm lifts from a neutral position, reaches to the side of its head near the temple, performs three quick taps, holds momentarily, then slowly withdraws as if in deep thought or acknowledging intelligence.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot's arm raises and positions the gripper near its temple, then performs a circular motion with the 'finger' (gripper tip) to imply thinking or 'being crazy', before slowly settling back.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot positions its gripper as an index finger near one side of its mouth, slides it across the lips to the other side, and makes a final upward flick, signifying secrecy or a refusal to speak.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot's arm (right arm assumed) moves from a neutral, slightly forward position, pulls inward, and then sweeps across the chest to settle firmly on the opposite side (left side), conveying a defensive or closed-off posture.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral mid-body position to firmly place its gripper on its hip, conveying confidence or annoyance, and then holds the pose before a slight relaxation.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot initially adopts an attentive posture (setup), then subtly leans forward while extending its arm with the 'palm open' gesture, holding to convey interest (core action), and finally settles into a slightly retracted but still engaged stance (follow-through).

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot begins in a neutral, attentive stance, then abruptly recoils backward with a rapid flinch, simultaneously raising its gripper forward and upward, palms out, in a gesture of shock or surprise. It holds this pose momentarily before slowly settling.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot's arm moves from a neutral position, quickly brings the palm to cover its mouth in a gesture of surprise or embarrassment, holds briefly, and then slowly lowers the hand to a settled position.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot positions its gripper hand at chest height, brings it inward to simulate pressing palms together, then bows forward respectfully, holds the pose, rises back up, and gently separates the hand to conclude the gesture of gratitude or respect.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot's arm starts in a neutral position, slowly rises as if holding a glass, executes a subtle 'clink' motion, holds the toast, and then gently lowers.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot's arm starts in a neutral, ready state, then performs an anticipatory lift, followed by a swift extension forward and upward to present an open, vertically-oriented palm for a high five, holding the inviting pose before gently retracting.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot anticipates a high five by raising its arm slowly, reaches to the peak position with its palm open and ready, then performs a swift downward swing as if making contact, and finally retracts the arm in a relaxed follow-through.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot prepares by drawing its arm back slightly, then extends a confident fist forward, holding the inviting pose, and finally eases back slightly.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot arm moves to a mid-chest position, then performs a sharp forward tap, followed by a slight recoil and a final gentle push, imitating a light fist bump, before settling back.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot prepares by drawing its arm slightly inward, then swiftly brings the gripper over its shoulder to its upper back, performing a series of confident patting motions, and finally withdraws with a gentle, satisfied return to a relaxed pose.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot prepares by raising its arm to eye level, then performs several quick circular motions with the wrist, gradually slowing down, and finally lowers its arm to indicate a circular or repetitive concept.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot positions its flat hand near the right side of its throat, then executes a swift horizontal 'slicing' motion across to the left, holding for emphasis, and finally retracts the arm in a decisive follow-through.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot's arm rises to position the back of its hand near the chin, then performs a quick, dismissive outward swipe, holding briefly before slowly withdrawing and lowering the arm.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot arm slowly lowers to a resting height, indicating initial patience. It then performs rapid, small up-and-down wrist movements simulating finger drumming, which gradually slows down, conveying growing boredom. The motion concludes with a slight upward lift and slow settling, signifying resignation.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot extends its arm slightly and leans forward in anticipation, then rapidly turns its palm upward while making subtle inward movements that suggest curling fingers, conveying an inviting 'give me' gesture, and finally settles into a receptive posture.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot arm starts in a low, ready position, then slowly and deliberately extends an open palm upwards and forwards, holding it briefly as an offering, before gently settling back.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot's arm begins in a neutral position, performs a slight preparatory backward movement, then sweeps upward and outward to a position beside its head in a gesture of surrender. It holds this pose to emphasize resignation, then slowly lowers the arm to a settled, accepting position.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot's arm slowly rises with tension, then quickly moves its gripper to the side of its head near the right ear, pressing in to block sound, holds the position, and finally lowers its arm in a relaxed, settled manner.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot's arm begins slightly retracted and at chest level, then gracefully sweeps wide outward, upward, and forward, holding the gripper open to convey an inviting, welcoming gesture. It then relaxes into a sustained open posture.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot arm starts in a neutral position, subtly pulls back to create tension, then slowly extends upward and outward as if stretching after a long period. It holds the full extension at its peak for a moment of relief, then gently lowers the arm and settles into a relaxed, open posture.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot prepares by slightly adjusting its arm, then swiftly brings its gripper to the forehead in a formal salute, holds it with conviction, and slowly lowers the arm.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot raises its arm deliberately (setup), quickly positions its gripper above the eyebrows like a visor to scan the horizon (core action), holds the searching pose, and then slowly lowers its arm (follow-through).
